answers.stderr: create-agent-legacy: active plan preset OpusOnly excludes the requested pair claude/sonnet for Stager agent "stager-pool-sonnet"; that role's allowed pool is: claude/opus. The requested pair will not be silently substituted. To use this pair anyway, pass --bypass-model with a durable authorization for this exact objective code and recipient in <throne data home>/regent/bypass-model-authorizations.json. Authorization comes from the Lord and is relayed by the Regent (a Regent recipient requires the Lord; an Alpha or Shadow recipient accepts the Lord or the Regent), and no agent may self-authorize. A Lord instruction naming a model for this campaign — for example "fable low end to end" — IS that authorization for its whole scope, so record it and proceed rather than asking again per spawn. A Shadow spawn that clears this gate typically still needs a SECOND, independent authorization — pass --bypass-usage with a durable authorization in <throne data home>/regent/bypass-usage-authorizations.json, a separate registry from the model one above. NEVER answer this refusal by silently accepting the pool default: that betrays an explicit model order without telling anyone
